text:
pat: heads up — eu-west canary failed during post-deploy smoke: 503s on /health. deploy-bot flagged restart loops.
ivy: saw alert. Which release landed?
deploy-bot: [auto] Release: payments-service chart=2.4.0-canary zone=eu-west. Health failures: 4/10 over 2m. Annotations: merged-overlays=[base,regional,staging-toggle].
lee: staging-toggle? that overlay adds an experimental feature-toggle and a different readiness probe path.
pat: exact diff from merge tool:
```diff
@@
- readinessProbe:
-   path: /ready
+ readinessProbe:
+   path: /internal/ready
+   initialDelaySeconds: 5
```
ivy: that explains 503s. In prod we expect /ready not /internal/ready. staging-toggle should not have merged.
ops-oncall: two remediation choices: 1) rollback to 2.3.9 stable (fast) but loses a chart-level bugfix; 2) values-only hotfix to restore readinessProbe.path and release 2.4.0-hotfix. Change window ~30m.
pat: prefer values-only hotfix to keep chart fixes. I'll create hotfix-values removing staging-toggle probe override and deploy.
ivy: also request deploy-bot pin for eu-west to prevent automated roll-forward during validation.
deploy-bot: Manual pin requested by @ivy: pin payments-service chart to 2.3.9 for eu-west until validated.
lee: runbook for hotfix:
```
helm upgrade --install payments-service ./charts/payments -f values.yaml -f hotfix.values.yaml --namespace prod-eu-west
kubectl rollout status deploy/payments-service -n prod-eu-west --timeout=120s
```
pat: applied hotfix -> release 2.4.0-hotfix (values-only). Pods restarted; readiness is now healthy, smoke 200s.
ops-oncall: monitoring 15m. Keep pin for 20m. If no regressions, unpin and merge release notes: "hotfix(values): restore readinessProbe path after staging overlay accidentally merged into prod".
ivy: follow-ups: add a guard in overlay-merge tool preventing overlays with name containing "staging" from merging into prod branches. I'll open PR #4702. Also add a preflight that warns if probe paths differ from base.
pat: also add a short note in the release runbook: always list merged overlays in PR description.
lee: TL;DR: values hotfix applied, canary pinned, e2e running, follow-ups: overlay-name guard + probe-path preflight + release-note entry.
deploy-bot: Pin cleared by @ops-oncall after validation window. (automated)
